Exercise: Crossover Reverse Lunge

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_lower_body

Primary Muscles:

- lower back

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- abductors
- glutes
- hamstrings
- quadriceps

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- condition: knee instability or injury, reason: high stress on the knee joint during the movement
- condition: lower back pain, reason: potential strain on the lower back muscles

Exercise Variations:

- name: Crossover Reverse Lunge with Dumbbell, weight: 5-10 kg per hand, reason: increases resistance and challenges core stability

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Reverse Lunge with Twist, reason: similar unilateral lower body movement pattern

Instructions:

- Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
- Perform a rear lunge by stepping back with one foot and flexing the hips and front knee. As you do so, rotate your torso across the front leg.
- After a brief pause, return to the starting position and repeat on the other side, continuing in an alternating fashion.
